class.name: SpineAnimationMix
class.brief_description: Crossfade duration between two named animations on a [code]SpineSkeletonDataResource[/code].
class.description: One entry in [code]SpineSkeletonDataResource.animation_mixes[/code]. [code]SpineAnimationState[/code] reads these values when it mixes from [code]from[/code] to [code]to[/code].

members.member: Source animation name for this mix entry.
Crossfade duration in seconds from [code]from[/code] to [code]to[/code].
Target animation name for this mix entry.
